description: Cropbox is a Julia framework for constructing and running crop growth models from declarative components. The maintainers provide examples covering leaf gas exchange, garlic and cabbage, root architecture, and a simplified crop model. Researchers supply crop process rules, parameters, site conditions and weather series, then obtain simulated crop states and yields from the model they build. Spatial coverage and time resolution depend on that supplied model; Cropbox itself is a framework, not one calibrated worldwide crop dataset. MIT-licensed source and documentation are publicly available through GitHub and Julia, with tutorial repositories and a cited methods article. A practical limitation is that a newly assembled crop model still needs local parameterisation and validation against observations. Framework examples are demonstrations, not evidence that all supported crops perform equally well. Cropbox can support irrigation-demand and agricultural production simulations. The catalogue's model-dssat-cropping-system-model is an established but separate crop-model suite for comparison; no import or coupling was checked. No example model was executed.
name: Cropbox declarative crop-model framework
